title.narrative: Red de Mujeres Trabajadoras Sexuales de Latinoamérica y el Caribe (RedTraSex)

description.narrative: The Network of Women Sex Workers of Latin America and the Caribbean (RedTraSex) is a network of National Organizations of Women Sex Workers (NWSOs) from: Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Chile, Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Peru and the Dominican Republic. They work to defend, promote, recognize and respect the human rights of FSWs, in particular their labor rights. Their vision is to eradicate social and institutional violence against sex workers, work with public officials and judicial systems to raise awareness of the challenges faced by sex workers, and increase their participation in decision-making spaces.The grant will support the following specific priorities:- Promotion at the regional and national levels;- Strengthening the capacities of RedTraSex and national organizations to implement advocacy and communication strategies;- Strategic communication to support advocacy efforts;- Research on the rights of sex workers and their working conditions.
